svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Island shapes (9)
svg.desc: Every tetromino orientation: the seven footprints of the app plus the mirror images of the L and the S (a flipped piece would show its blank back). Seven go out each voyage. Wavy coast, corners rounded to a quarter of a square, a small dovetail notch in the middle of every outside edge for a dock — 3 mm at the mouth, 2.4 deep, under where the ingredient sits. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 6 mm material. No kerf compensation in this file — it is a design view; cut from the sheet-N files. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
